g.text: UML - Immutable Finance observation and independent liquidity
save UTC period + stable request UUID
one snapshot: account stocks, commitments, journals and legs
separate consistent GL / chart / receipt snapshot
original export documents / proofs + Finance as-of
Both database read transactions close before HTTP.
The source clocks remain explicit; no global atomicity is claimed.
signed original cash evidence or missing / invalid / stale
exact controls and source / date / mapping / receipt checks
cash unavailable unless fresh; expected funds remain separate
under request lock: immutable summary / members / proofs / issues / audit
recover lost case assignment acknowledgments in bounded pages
snapshot URL / controls / digests / safe evidence
reopen snapshot; page frozen source lineage
original artifact, membership, captured proof archives
derive current freshness without rewriting artifact
original captured report + separate current evidence status
Reporting has no reserve, release or booking command.
Later observations never rewrite earlier reports.
